class_provenance_warning:
These are recorded here from the fan wikis, but nobody has yet opened the
    VGO Emulator client and confirmed them. They may be exactly right, they may
    carry figures the game never used, or they may not be in the emulator at
    all — there is no way to tell from the sources alone.
    
      Of this class's 196 abilities,
      152 have had their tooltip read in game, and 27 were looked for and not
      found .
    
    Where a tooltip has been read it overrides the wikis, and around four in
    five disagreed with them — so treat the figures below with care.
limitations: Rows without strict class-source snapshots remain explicit coverage gaps; no identities or missing fields are inferred.
Only top-level Necromancer records carrying the exact class URL are compared. Cross-class top-level records are retained in full and excluded; nested variants are not promoted.
Same-provenance parser snapshots are not independent corroboration.
Fan-wiki and modern emulator qualifications from the input review still apply.
Literal differences require source review before any mechanics are promoted. All operative values remain null.
Detail-page typed values with explicit units must be reviewed separately; bare table numbers do not establish their units.
